The Story

A good host reads the room first

Off stage, he's Vinay Batra. On it, he's The Modish Monk — a name that pairs a sharp eye for style with a monk's calm under pressure. He briefs with the organiser, learns who is in the room, and keeps the programme moving without ever rushing anyone.

Online, he shares that same mix of calm and colour with his followers, and works with brands that fit that voice.

  • 01

    Emcee & hosting

    Galas, community events, festivals, panels and award nights.

  • 02

    Brand partnerships

    Launches, campaigns and appearances that fit his audience.

  • 03

    Content & reels

    Short video and photo stories for your brand or event.

Also a Coach

Public speaking coaching

Vinay also trains people to hold a room the way he does — for interviews, stages, weddings or just everyday confidence. Sessions are one-on-one or in small groups, over video call or in person.

1:1

Personal coaching

A focused session built around your goal — a speech, an interview, a toast, or simply speaking up with more ease.

  • Voice, pacing and stage presence
  • Script and structure feedback
  • Recorded practice with notes
GR

Group workshops

Hands-on sessions for teams, colleges or communities who want to build confident speakers together.

  • Half-day or full-day formats
  • Live practice and group feedback
  • Icebreakers and improv drills
CO

Corporate training

Presentation and communication training for teams preparing for pitches, town halls or client-facing roles.

  • Custom to your industry
  • On-site or remote
  • Follow-up practice materials

Coaching enquiries are handled over DM — reach out on Instagram or WhatsApp and mention "coaching" to get started.

Simple Process

How booking works

1. Reach out

Send your date, city and what you need — event hosting or coaching — over the form, Instagram or WhatsApp.

2. Discuss the brief

A short call to align on the vibe of the event or the goal of the coaching session, and confirm availability.

3. Show up ready

Vinay preps with the details in hand, so the room — or the session — runs exactly as planned.

Good to know

Frequently asked

How far in advance should we book?

As early as possible once your date is fixed — popular weekends and festival dates fill up fastest.

Does he host in multiple languages?

Add the real answer here — which languages he hosts in and any regional preferences.

Can he travel outside the city?

Add the real answer here — travel radius, and whether travel and stay are billed separately.

What's included in a media kit?

Follower count and audience breakdown, past brand partners, sample rates, and full contact details.

Get in touch

Planning an event or a campaign?

Tell him the date, the city and what you have in mind. He'll reply by email.

  • Media kit and rates available on request
  • Available for in-person and online events
